Grammar: 快要/快/就要/要……了 (expressing that an action or change is about to happen; structure to use in the group-work activity)
新年你想在哪儿过？ (Xīnnián nǐ xiǎng zài nǎr guò?) - Where do you want to spend the New Year?
你想和谁一起过新年？ (Nǐ xiǎng hé shéi yìqǐ guò xīnnián?) - Who do you want to spend the New Year with?
你想送给朋友什么新年礼物？ (Nǐ xiǎng sòng gěi péngyou shénme xīnnián lǐwù?) - What New Year gift do you want to give to your friends?
下个月5号是弟弟的生日，他快要15岁了。 (Xià ge yuè wǔ hào shì dìdi de shēngrì, tā kuàiyào shíwǔ suì le.) - Next month on the 5th is my younger brother's birthday; he is about to turn 15.

春节是中国人的“新年”，是中国最重要的传统节日。 (Chūnjié shì Zhōngguórén de “xīnnián”, shì Zhōngguó zuì zhòngyào de chuántǒng jiérì.) - Spring Festival, or the Chinese New Year, is the most important traditional festival in China.
春节是个欢乐祥和的节日，也是亲人团聚的日子。 (Chūnjié shì ge huānlè xiánghé de jiérì, yě shì qīnrén tuánjù de rìzi.) - It is a happy, merry day when family members have a reunion.

每年春节的时候，离家在外的人们都会赶回家中，和亲人一起过春节。 (Měi nián Chūnjié de shíhou, lí jiā zàiwài de rénmen dōu huì gǎn huí jiā zhōng, hé qīnrén yìqǐ guò Chūnjié.) - Every year during the Spring Festival, people away from home will return home to celebrate the festival with their families.

大家一起贴对联、放鞭炮、吃饺子、看春节联欢晚会，高高兴兴地过年。 (Dàjiā yìqǐ tiē duìlián, fàng biānpào, chī jiǎozi, kàn Chūnjié liánhuān wǎnhuì, gāogāoxìngxìng de guònián.) - Together they paste antithetical couplets, light off firecrackers, eat dumplings, and watch the Spring Festival Gala happily and cheerfully.

孩子们最喜欢过春节了，因为他们可以从长辈那里得到压岁钱。 (Háizimen zuì xǐhuan guò Chūnjié le, yīnwèi tāmen kěyǐ cóng zhǎngbèi nàli dédào yāsuìqián.) - Kids love the Spring Festival best because they can get money from their elders as gifts.

节日的热烈气氛不仅洋溢在各家各户，也充满大街小巷。 (Jiérì de rèliè qìfēn bùjǐn yángyì zài gè jiā gè hù, yě chōngmǎn dàjiē xiǎoxiàng.) - The bustling, festive ambience fills not only every household, but also the streets and lanes.

一些地方还会有舞狮子、耍龙灯、逛庙会等文化活动。 (Yìxiē dìfang hái huì yǒu wǔ shīzi, shuǎ lóngdēng, guàng miàohuì děng wénhuà huódòng.) - In some places, there are such cultural activities as lion dances, dragon-lantern shows and temple fairs, etc.
